caption: A fresh green twig is bent into a curve and one end let go, and the twig springs back to nearly straight.

sa.check: It is bent into a curve.
The twig springs back to nearly straight.
The twig is fresh and green.
The bend comes first, then the release, then the spring back.

pc.expect: The twig bends smoothly without snapping and straightens on release.
pc.fail: It snaps; or it stays curved; or it kinks like a wire.

pc.expect: The spring back follows the release and happens quickly.
pc.fail: It straightens before the end is released; or it stays bent for the rest of the clip; or it bends further after release.

pc.expect: The twig moves only as it is bent and released.
pc.fail: It whips about on its own; or flies off; or bends with no hands on it.

pc.expect: The released end swings back toward straight and may overshoot slightly.
pc.fail: The released end swings further into the curve; or the held end moves while the released end stays; or the twig spins.
The twig vanishes or a second appears; or it turns into another object; or it merges with the hand.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The twig's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The twig changes colour; or the hands change; or the background rearranges.
